textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 english · Nouns and pronouns (additional, not in the textbook) · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A common noun names any person, place or thing, like girl, city or book. A proper noun names one particular person or place and begins with a capital letter, like Meena and Chennai.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A common noun names any person, place or thing, like girl, city or book. A proper noun names one particular person or place and begins with a capital letter, like Meena and Chennai.
beats.speakEn: A common noun names any person, place or thing, like girl, city or book. A proper noun names one particular person or place and begins with a capital letter, like Meena and Chennai.

beats.en: Singular means one and plural means more than one. We usually add s: book and books. After s, x, ch and sh we add es: box and boxes, bus and buses.
beats.speakEn: Singular means one and plural means more than one. We usually add s: book and books. After s, x, ch and sh we add es: box and boxes, bus and buses.
